item-1.question: What is Desktop Pet?
item-1.answer: Desktop Pet brings realistic companions like Hua and Gucci to your desktop. They sit, walk, and sleep on your screen—in the browser playground or as a native desktop app.

item-2.question: Do I need an account to play?
item-2.answer: No. You can try pets in the browser playground and download the desktop companion without signing up.

item-3.question: How do I try it in the browser?
item-3.answer: Open the Playground from the navigation. Hua and Gucci will appear on a simulated desktop—right-click a pet to wander, walk, or sleep.

item-4.question: Where can I use DeskPet—browser or desktop?
item-4.answer: Both. Try pets in the browser playground, or download the desktop companion for macOS (universal DMG for Apple Silicon and Intel) and Windows. Visit Download for the matching installer.

item-5.question: Can I use my own pet?
item-5.answer: Not yet—custom pets are coming soon. For now you can play with companions like Hua and Gucci in the playground and desktop app.

item-6.question: What can I use AI credits for?
item-6.answer: AI credits power pet image generation, pet video generation, custom interactions, medical record summaries, invoice parsing, receipt OCR, and more. Since your pet's photos, health records, expenses, and memories are already organized in DeskPet, AI can provide more personalized results without requiring you to upload or explain everything again.

item-7.question: What happens if I run out of AI credits?
item-7.answer: You can buy more AI credits whenever you need them. Your free DeskPet features will keep working even if your credits run out.
